tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All other terms and conditions mentioned in the bid document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Statement of past performance of at least three years as per format section-IX. On the tenderers letter head.

Previous purchase order copies of Drugs & other items supplied to Govt. Hospitals or Institutions or Autonomous institutions or Private hospitals in the year 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26 should be uploaded. Uploaded documents must be attested by notary. Quoted items or similar items supplied Purchase order copies should be uploaded.

User certificate copies of Drugs & other items supplied to Govt. Hospitals or Institutions or Autonomous institutions or Private hospitals in the year 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26 should be uploaded. Uploaded documents must be attested by notary.
GST registration certificate GST R-3B certificates from April 2026 to July 2026 should be uploaded.

PAN Copy, ITR, Profit and Loss statement and Balance Sheet issued by Chartered Accountant for the Financial Year 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25 should be uploaded. Uploaded documents must be attested by notary.

Annual turnover statement issued by CA for the financial year 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25 should be uploaded. The annual turnover of the firm for every year is not less than Rs. 200.00 lakhs as otherwise the tender is liable to be rejected.
Signed Tender offer Form, Name of the Firm with Full Address, contact Numbers and email Address, On the tenderers letter head.
List of Items quoted in this tender should be uploaded by mentioning the manufacturer company name of the product, Pack size etc. On the tenderers letter head.

Manufacturer Authorization Form from Principal Manufacturer for the relevant items as per section VII, Annexure I with Drug license copy of manufacturer. In the authorization form name of the products should be mentioned.
Valid GMP or WHO or FDA or any relevant Certificates of the manufacturer should be uploaded.
Valid Drug License of the Bidder should be uploaded.
Valid No conviction certificate issued by Drug controller for the participation in this tender should be uploaded as per format section XII.

Self declaration stating that the firm is not black listed with any Government or semi Government Organizations and will not supply refurbished items to be furnished on a stamp paper of Rs 100 as per proforma section XI. Uploaded document must be attested by notary.
Self declaration stating that the tenderer shall be abide by all the terms and conditions of the tender to be furnished on a stamp paper of Rs.100
